say:2:1041311001:1.text: Don't hand me that turnip soup, Bryon...
say:2:1041311001:1.source_cn: 布莱恩，不要递给我那份芜菁豆子汤……

say:3:1041311002:1.text: Don't try to fool me! I heard the person in charge of the kitchen say that it was a turnip!
say:3:1041311002:1.source_cn: 别想蒙骗我！我亲耳听到今天掌厨的人说那是芜菁！

say:4:1041311003:1.text: Your control of your listening seems to have improved...
say:4:1041311003:1.source_cn: ……你对声音的掌控似乎有所提升？

say:5:1041311004:1.text: It seems like it. Maybe it's because Ivoryshade is so quiet.
say:5:1041311004:1.source_cn: 这么一说，好像是！也许是因为月影乡足够安静？

say:6:1041311005:1.text: That means it's better for you to live out here in seclusion to exercise and develop your abilities.
say:6:1041311005:1.source_cn: 这么说，你比较适合隐居在这里锻炼自己的能力。

say:7:1041311006:1.text: Good idea! I can improve my listening abilities and not be constantly nagged by Master Arden. I'll definitely consider this!
say:7:1041311006:1.source_cn: 好主意！能提升耳力，还能避开雅顿老爷子的唠叨……不错啊...
